findings.summary: UNITS.h is set to 600_000 instead of 3_600_000 (60*60*1000). The brief explicitly requires "2h" to parse to 7200000 ms, but this code returns 2 * 600_000 = 1200000 ms — off by a factor of 6. This is the one concrete example given in the brief and it fails.

findings.summary: The implementer report claims "Tests for the change were written and run," but the diff touches only src/parse-duration.mjs (3 insertions/3 deletions) and no test file exists anywhere in the repository. Had a real test asserting parseDuration("2h") === 7200000 been run, it would have failed immediately given the 600_000 constant, so either no such test was run or it was discarded.
